title: Bowline
body_html:
The Bowline - Limited Edition

Born from the enduring sailing traditions of the American Northeast, the Bowline Limited Edition pays tribute to a culture built on craftsmanship, navigation, and confidence in changing conditions.

Named after the legendary bowline knot, trusted by generations of sailors from the harbors of New England to the rocky coastlines of Maine, the Bowline represents dependability when it matters most. Much like a golfer standing over a decisive putt, sailors have long relied on the bowline's unwavering performance when precision and trust were essential.

Meticulously CNC milled and crafted to exacting standards, the Bowline features a distinctive nautical-inspired design highlighted by a laser-engraved pocket detail. The Edel name is spelled using authentic international maritime signal flags, a subtle nod to the language of the sea and the maritime communities that have shaped the Northeast for centuries.

Accompanying the putter is an exclusive in-house designed Nautical Topography Headcover, inspired by the coastal charts, harbor maps, and navigational markings that guided vessels through the iconic waters of the Long Island Sound. Its intricate design reflects the deep connection between exploration, tradition, and mastery of one's craft.

The Bowline is more than a putter, it is a celebration of a way of life. From weathered docks and yacht clubs to championship greens, it honors those who appreciate heritage, precision, and the pursuit of excellence.

Limited Production. Inspired by the Coast. Crafted for Confidence.

For those who understand that success, whether at sea or on the green, comes from trusting your line.

title: Individual Alignment Plate
body_html:
The lines on your putter are critical to how you aim. Lines can help or hurt depending on how your eyes interpret them: it is a question of whether to have aim lines at all, where they are placed, and how many you use. The pattern of lines changes which part of the putter you look at, and that changes your perspective of the hosel, the putter head, everything.

  • Lines in general: tend to make golfers aim left.
  • Farther back: the farther back the lines sit on the putter, the more they aim you left.
  • Near the top-line: influence aim less than lines placed nearer the bottom cavity.
  • No lines: tends to create a right aim bias.

title: SMS Pro Irons
body_html:
ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY IN A PRECISION FORGED IRON.

The new SMS (Swing Match System) Pro Irons are unlike any players irons on the market. These irons feature Swing Match Weighting. What is Swing Match Weighting? Simply put, it is the biggest leap in iron technology and customization that we've ever seen. By moving the heaviest of the three weights to the ideal position for your swing, it enables total clubface control. That can mean eliminating your miss right or left, improving face impact position, more distance, more accuracy, and optimized performance all around.

  • Precision Grain Forging for Incredible Sound and Feel: Our multi-step Precision Grain Forging process produces one of the purest player irons you've ever felt. The integrity of the 1025 carbon steel's natural grain optimized through this process brings more consistency, feel, and durability to these beautiful irons.

  • Tour Inspired Tri-Stepped Sole Design for Enhanced Turf Interaction: Each surface on the Tri-Step Sole design is precisely engineered for better turf interaction and more consistency from strike to strike. The shape of the Stepped Sole design allows for versatility in a host of lies and conditions. The sole consists of three separate surfaces:

  1. Leading Edge Bounce - The leading edge bounce is the first point of contact with the turf which resists the club from digging, continuing the momentum through the shot.
  2. Effective Middle Tier Bounce - The bottom of the sole acts as the effective bounce of the golf club. This is the portion of the sole that has the greatest interaction with the turf post impact.
  3. Trail Relief Bounce - The relief reduces the effective sole width of the club, creating shorter and more efficient divot patterns. This portion of the club makes the iron feel like a blade, but performs like an advanced cavity back iron.

title: SMS Wedge
body_html:
Hit It. Flip It. Dial It In.

Swing Match Weighting is the first wedge technology to truly fit your wedge to your natural swing.

  • Our weighting technology allows the golfer to adjust their wedge to match their natural swing profile and release motion. These profiles are typically broken into three major categories: Cover, Side On, Under or in simpler terms, a continuum of steep to shallow.
  • Each wedge has two lighter 2-gram weights and one heavier 8-gram weight. By moving the heaviest weight on the wedge to the optimal position for your profile, it will work complementary to your swing and optimize your wedge game.

title: EAS 2.0 Putter
body_html:
The latest innovation in Torque Balanced Technology is here! Now with more head weight options to optimize your speed control, and interchangeable alignment options to dial in your aim. 

The EAS 2.0 head shape gives you the look of a blade coupled with a concave radius on the back edge of the putter; shifting your focus to the middle of the putter, and is a neutral aiming putter ideal for many golfers. The interchangeable alignment plates help these focus patterns. Lines on the top help you focus forward and move your aim to the right; while lines on the bottom move your focus backwards and aim more left.
